title: Theodoretus
summary: Raleigh names Theodoretus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Theodoretus, also printed Theodoret. He says the book of Iasher was a commentary upon Iosua. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book I, Part I, Chapter I, §. VI, sig. 46b
